subject: Game Theory
title: What Is an Auction?
description: A quick win: understand What Is an Auction?.

hook.text: An auction is a market where the price isn't set—it's discovered through competition among buyers.

buildup.text: Sellers don't know what buyers will pay. Auctions reveal that hidden information through bidding.

discovery.text: The ancient Romans auctioned war spoils. Babylon auctioned brides. Auctions predate money itself.

twist.text: Unlike fixed prices, auctions can extract more from eager buyers—or collapse if nobody bids.

climax.text: Today auctions sell everything from art to airwaves, flowers to financial bonds.

punchline.text: Let the market speak through bids.

quiz.question: What do auctions primarily reveal?
options: What buyers are willing to pay
